source: QED 3-loop electron self-energy — Mercedes-Benz rim 2-leg. Graph: central hub O + 3 photon spokes (O-A, O-B, O-C) + 5 electron rim arcs (A-M, M-B, B-C, C-N, N-A) where M, N are the 2 external attachment points (M on A-B rim arc, N on C-A rim arc, so A is between M and N). ext_in -> M, ext_out -> N. Mass: 3 spokes massless (photon), 5 rim arcs mass m_e (electron). ON-SHELL kinematics p1^2 = msq = 1 (electron on mass shell). Loop momenta: l1 = e_OA, l2 = e_OB, l3 = e_NA (with e_OC = -(l1+l2) from O Kirchhoff). EMPIRICAL NOTE: despite graph being non-chain (hub + rim cycle vs linear chain in LA3/CL3), AMFlow reduction is ~8x faster than LA3/CL3 — Mercedes hub symmetry makes Kira IBP system far smaller (DE prepared = 10 sub-systems vs ~90 for LA3/CL3).
